notes.title: HypeTrain News: Steam Next Fest + New Title!
notes.content:
Heya! 

We're aware that no one likes to read long off-topic updates, so let's get straight to the point: two of our games will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we'd love it if you'd give their demos a chance. We can't promise a complete match to your tastes, but the quality is guaranteed.

The first one is Die in the Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice. Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters. Oh, and the protagonist here is a cute little frog - everyone loves frogs, right?

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2026820/extras/gameplay.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026820/Die_in_the_Dungeon

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2608270/extras/Stealth_Approach_-_I2.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608270/Intravenous_2/

This post should have ended here, as there is no third game for the Fest. BUT there is a third, freshly revealed game that we would still like to present to you, so here we go: 

Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world where survival is only possible in the canyons. Play solo or gather a team of up to four players. Arm yourselves to the teeth, grab supplies, and set out to conquer the canyons on massive Crawlers. This one won't have a demo anytime soon, but if it's up your alley, be sure to wishlist the game so you don't miss out on it.

notes.title: Major Update: combat, FPS boost, character appearance and improved lighting
notes.content:
Hello, Volunteers! 

We bring you the big Desolate update! New combat system, new animations, improved enemy reactions, redesigned character appearances, and a lighting upgrade that will give you up to +20 FPS performance boost depending on your PC. 

[h2]New Combat System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/cb226413d80e40ce96ff866e40d6a6bf54534bdf.gif[/img]

You've given us a lot of feedback on what could be improved in Desolate. In particular, you talked about how melee in the game could get better. You asked, and we delivered! Meet the new combat system in Desolate. 

[b]New Kicks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/7edfbf7029bd84fafe7acb0768fda11748c623fc.gif[/img]

Now, in addition to the usual attacks in the game, kicking appeared. By pressing the F key, you can kick your opponent and push him away from you. This way you can get time to choose a new attack strategy or to run away.

[b]Counterattacks[/b]

Previously, Desolate had the ability to block attacks. After your feedback, we decided to add the ability not only to block them, but also to parry! Clicking the left mouse button right after a successful block will now damage your opponent and briefly stun them.

[b]Combo Attacks, Accuracy and Animations[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/75c273659d96269512ba5d2e7ec01000f271f61d.gif[/img]

As we promised, Desolate is getting new combo attacks! Thanks to them, melee became more dynamic and diverse, and you can deal more damage. There are two combo attacks:

[list]
[*] Combo attack #1: Normal attack (left mouse button) + normal attack + kick (F key). The opponent will receive increased damage and will be thrown away at a further distance than from the normal kick.
[*] Combo attack #2: Block (right mouse button) + kick + normal attack. The scope of the final attack will become larger, which you can understand by the special animation of the camera! 
[/list]

We've also added accuracy to your punches, so they don't go through enemy models. Plus, as you may have already noticed, there are new camera effects in close combat. This will add dynamic, cinematic effect to your battles.

[b]Reaction of Opponents in Battle[/b]

In addition to the new mechanics, we have significantly improved the reactions of enemies to blows. Humanoid NPCs now have separate new animations in response to being hit. But that's not all! Blood effects on cutting weapons - are no longer an explosion of black liquid, but a directed spray of blood. 

It is important to understand if your hit connected during combat. Everytime your attack hits, you'll know by the way camera reacts and slight weapon jamming.

[h2]Updated Lighting and FPS Boost [/h2]

We redesigned the lighting in the open world and in some rooms. The light has become natural, and the performance of Desolate improved as well - on different configurations the FPS increase is from +1-5 to +20.

We will continue to improve lighting and FPS stability in Desolate throughout the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/c74d2560c1290b819eeed6e298d2cdcfc391d61f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/1ca0c8ed0a3e575d4fc2ebb1a75dc76bf58882eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/310577005aec03fbfcdf5ca5423d317fe7b34f1d.png[/img]

[h2]Appearance Options[/h2]

Now you can play Desolate with a style. We have thoroughly improved the facial models available for selection, as well as redesigned the appearances of hairstyles and beards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/9857b292e25df0f12664832914ebe741811c80b8.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next [/h2]

Thank you for the feedback you give! It helps us make Desolate better. We will continue to improve the game further - now we plan to work on the game's balance, improve the open world and it's main questline and further the improvements of the NPC AI.

We hope you enjoy this big update and give us even more feedback and support. If it wasn't for you, it wouldn't be here!

Don't forget to subscribe to our Discord, where you can find company to play together, as well as chat with developers from Nearga: https://discord.gg/wYpBfgDD

notes.title: Beta-test of the new combat system
notes.content:
Hello Volunteers! Today we invite you to test the new Desolate combat system before the big free update launches. 

[h2]Beta test: combo attacks, new punches and AI[/h2]

The purpose of the beta test is to test the combat system before it arrives in the next big update. To put it simply, you should just have a good fight with the madmen, using any melee weapon available and more, because now you can kick them too!

Testing takes place in two locations: in a special space in the open world (with boundaries for movement) and in the Desolate prologue, which you can fully complete.

[b][i][u]Important - backup your autosaves! Please note that the beta test may overwrite your autosaves - normal saves will not be affected. However, we advise you to make a backup copy of your saves and move them to another folder just in case. [/u][/i][/b]

[h3]A list of updates you can try and test:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/301dd3d727728994a8005a2ecc63a17bd1cdcfbc.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Kicking. Now you can kick your opponent and thus either knock him away from you or break his block.
[*] Combo attacks. Click twice on the normal attack button (Left mouse button) and then immediately click on the kick (F button) - the opponent will receive increased damage and will be thrown away at a greater distance. Or you can start the attack with a kick and then click the left mouse button - the normal attack becomes stronger. Combo attacks only work if you have a melee weapon in your hand!
[*] Counterattacks. You can now repel attacks. To do this, press the left and right mouse buttons simultaneously.
[*] New hit animations. Pay attention to the camera sway during fights, and how enemy models react to a blow, especially when falling down. We've added more physics to their movements and reactions to blows.
[*] AI. We're working on the group intelligence of enemies. In this build, they don't just pounce on you in droves, but act tactically. While one is attacking you, the other is sidestepping or waiting for the right moment to do the most damage.
[/list]
Anyone can participate in the beta testing of the new combat system from May 27 to 31.

notes.title: Desolate: Fight and Light
notes.content:
Hello, Volunteers! Nearga Studios here. Today we will talk (and show) about Desolate improvements in the upcoming free update.

[h2]Combat system: combos, new punches, animations, accuracy[/h2]

For the last three months our team has been working on melee combat in Desolate, and we can finally share the results. One of the things you can now do is kick your opponents. This will help you push your enemy away to escape or get a breather. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/b8023dd04871acfc2a161532f7aeaca2eaa558f8.gif[/img]

Combos are coming to Desolate. Left-clicking is our thing, but if you add kicks to that, you'll get a truly irresistible series of attacks! You'll even get a solid damage booster at the end of the combo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/466611c86bdd9ab0b4316e69086b38ee7f3ec1b8.gif[/img]

We're also working on improving animations and character movements. They will become more natural and flexible, and the time between melee hits will be reduced. This should make fights a lot more comfortable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/beeaa631cb6c483833845a3b6d6628891c9965c3.gif[/img]

After reading your feedback, we decided to redesign the melee weapon hitbox system. Now hitting an opponent is counted along the entire length of an object, so the hits will be more accurate and realistic. See what it looks like before improvements and after.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/191362b0a1b21bfe74fc10ae4c1c9b852a51352d.gif[/img]

[h2]Illumination and reflections [/h2]

Desolate is an atmospheric game and we decided to improve the quality of lights, shadows and reflections of objects. Don't worry, the system requirements won't get higher - we are also thoroughly working on optimization of all the things we update. Check out the beautiful screenshots with the upcoming visual updates! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/18251ef383213334ecbb305dd9c57977f0db69b4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/2de01486f296656ba1c37a17f838eaa7fc25dbd0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/bb5e43f7cca2d47499d76750539f22a598a59d5b.png[/img]

[h2]What's next [/h2]

These are just some of the upgrades that will be delivered in the next free Desolate update. Right now we're working on optimizing the main quests, creating new customization options, and improving AI. 

We'll tell you more about that in the future devlogs! The update release date announcement is coming soon as well. 

Stay tuned, volunteers!

notes.title: DESOLATE: Roadmap and Updates
notes.content:
Hello Volunteers! This is not a voice in your head, this is us — developers from Nearga.

We are happy to announce that loads of free improvements and expansions are coming to DESOLATE soon! We continue to work on many things regarding Granichny Island and its inhabitants — from new versions of Volunteer’s appearance to the improved combat system, quests and environment. 

Today we want to share our plans for the next update with you, as well as uncover plans for the whole year ahead. Check your equipment and let’s get started! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/2ac12cffb98e6af1c3e574018d2ce75c41dd86dd.png[/img]
[h2]Close combat improvement (early spring 2021)[/h2]

Your main ally in DESOLATE are your melee weapons (apart from savvy and sanity, of course). That’s why we decided to develop this mechanic into something deeper. Battles with enemies will now get more interesting and spectacular than before.

[list]
[*] 3 distinct types of weapons will appear in the game, each with its own features: heavy, medium and light. 
[*] Battles will get more tactical: you’ll have to adapt to your opponents, pick a strategy, keep track of your stamina and search for a vantage point. 
[*] You will be able to risk and try to parry your enemy’s attacks, in case of success you will gain an advantage. 
[*] New animations will let you feel the battle dynamics and attack impacts better.
[/list]
[h2]Characters’ visual improvement[/h2]

A book is judged by its cover, right? We’ll make the appearances of the in-game characters more detailed and polished. Same thing applies to some of the environment objects. 

[list]
[*] New hairstyles, beards and facial options for the character creation
[*] New starter suit for the main character
[*] Environment 3D models and textures update
[/list]
[h2]Elaboration of the storyline, quests and gameplay[/h2]

Everything regarding story quests will be improved: locations, fast travel points, quest geography, and even voiceover. 
[h2]And more...[/h2]

But that’s not everything. In 2021 we’ll enhance artificial intelligence in Desolate. Enemies will get smarter, and clashes with them will become truly life-threatening. As for the visuals, Desolate will get even more good-looking thanks to the textures’ update.

Keep an eye on the updates and stay tuned, Volunteers!

Do you miss the golden era of Game Boy? https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111590/Linked_Mask/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/f8610a50c9a9492fa4b446b492de33263cedb4ad.gif[/img]

Plunge into a VHS-era cyberpunk world of Jack Move, an RPG featuring japanese style turn based battles and gorgeous Hi-Bit pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0yOLVvhsJFw

There’s a brand new demo of Jack Move available that features a new slums area, a new dungeon and a whole bunch of new enemies for you to tangle with. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099640/Jack_Move/

Black Book is a dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic mythology and featuring card-based combat. You will take on the role of Vasilisa, a young sorceress on a quest to revive her beloved one. In order to do so, she has to uncover all the 7 seals of Black Book — a demonic artefact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish. 

The demo features an essential part of the story — the First Day of Vasilisa becoming a witch. You’ll be able to test test the core game mechanics, battle regular demons and even test your strength in a fight against a boss.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

In this demo you’ll be able to explore a small part of the game world. Visit a village, the existence of which remained unknown for a long time. Find out how people live in the underground world ruled by the Church of the Great Hand. Find your own playstyle by combining 3 available weapon types, so that eventually you can fight a giant boss Behemoth that gets in your way to freedom.

The demo is a linear and brief sample of a run in one of the Castle's areas. notes.title: Cryptozoologist's Diary. Continuing the study
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/815fbb21dcabe1b1f16f7ea277c2d21dbb09d7df.png[/img]
Fascinated by previous findings, our nameless cryptozoologist continues to study the creatures of Granichny. This time not all mutants are aggressive killing machines -- which serves to show that the island has its own unique ecosystem, and not just an army of bloodthirsty mutants.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/4d359c5a118a0d5086e58fa31edf19b1f15d81c5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Sapsy[/b][/h1]

Medium sized, four legged creature with drop-shaped body and a row of spines running on its back. Despite its feeble looks, sapsy has an extraordinary amount of strength. One case in particular mentioned how sapsy managed to nearly destroy a steel bar from the cage it was contained in. This beast is predatory and also incredibly aggressive. While the creature prefers meat, it also does seem to be an omnivore. 
Its saliva has unique restorative properties and could potentially be used in creating new medicine. Unfortunately, in its natural form saliva interacts differently with epidermis and muscle fibers. While accelerating healing rate for skin wounds, it has an opposite effect on muscles, causing a deep necrosis in the tissue. Though, sapsy seems to use the saliva to heal its own wounds without any side effects.
Sapsy is very hard to fend off from -- it has no fear and seems to only become more and more aggravated. Many encounters with the beast point to the fact that sapsy relies more on its eyesight. It is highly advised not to underestimate this creature when encountered as it may easily result in death.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/8d984b1dc3e660159471b9afb501ac30f6c93cf7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Churaka[/b][/h1]

Quadrupedal herbivore that very vaguely resembles a common pig. Cowardly and timid, churaka tries to flee in the faintest sense of danger. Previously inhabiting european forests, about 50 specimen were transported to Granichny for studying in close to natural conditions. Mutations caused by Day X  changed the creature’s physiology, but did not have any noticeable effect on its behavior. 
Churaka is surprisingly agile and fast, so blindly chasing it proved to be rather difficult. According to different reports, it may also possess exceptional reflexes that allow churaka to dodge even a shot from a firearm. The creature also uses an incredibly loud and high pitched screech to confuse its pursuer. While the screech is not strong enough to rupture one’s the inner ear, it is still dangerous since prolonged exposure can deal irreversible damage to hearing organs. Churaka’s scream can also attract other, more dangerous creatures. Because of this, in most cases it is best to leave the beast to its own devices.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/71ca31ff1b69b2592de08a4e78dad8b3cfade190.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Quacker [/b][/h1]

Quacker has very deceptive looks: bulky front body with scaly skin, glowing overgrowth on its head and a huge mouth. Yet it is a very peaceful herbivore creature that’s easily scared. Quackers might be the animals whose appearance was affected the most by the transformation after Day X. Prior to the event they’ve had much more appealing looks and were covered in short fur. Quacker’s area of inhabitat has also changed -- from forest groves to bogs. The creature’s diet mostly consist of roots and low-growing plants.
Quackers have a very keen hearing which they use to avoid danger. The creature can notice even a faintest crack of a broken branch or a shallowest breathing. Hunters that attempt to catch it have to be incredibly patient and careful. 
Quackers are a popular source of food among people of Granichny. The creature’s meat is stiff and contains a lot of ‘Moss’ when fresh, but after proper heat treatment it becomes more than edible. Quacker’s skin is also used in craftsmanship, bolstering great durability. The New Light Conglomerate even holds plans for possible domestication of these creatures after condition of Granichy becomes more stable.

notes.title: Cryptozoologist's Diary
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/a35a1e61973ea672291b55e6ccdd5074707e77bd.png[/img]

The island of Granichny contains a lot of mysteries. And on par with anomalies, the most common ones are its endemic lifeforms. Mutated after the catastrophic event known as Day X, these creatures have ghoulish appearance and behave quite aggressively. But what if someone wanted to study them as a cryptozoologist? Let’s imagine how his notes would look like in today’s post!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/d6d0ca7aa9b59c443cb4c0529c72d78208452725.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Madmen[/b][/h1]

Once completely normal human beings, they’ve lost all traces of their personality after the Day X. In their usual state Madmen usually aimlessly roam around without any purpose, mumbling random words and phrases devoid of any meaning. Such behavior led to multiple cases where people, out of compassion or other personal reasons, thought it was possible to reach out to madmen and help them regain their sanity. This was, frankly, not possible -  and those who tried to help these creatures found themselves in dire situations, which sometimes led to their death. It all ties to a fact, that if madmen see a human unaffected by impact of Day X, they go into an uncontrollable rage, trying to attack the survivor. And while a single madman poses little threat, these subjects can somehow communicate between each other, calling out for their kin in case of a human encounter. 

The state that madmen are in is believed to be caused by the green substance called ‘The Moss’. Speculations suggest that the liquid accumulating inside the madman’s lymphatic system causes a mutation and maybe, somehow, makes its victim a part of cognitive network of Madmen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/874d9fbb25f859539a939546262e04b52db22e4c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Dorgs[/b][/h1]

Incredibly aggressive creatures who are relentless and fearless in pursuit of their victim. Most researchers agree that dorgs a result of stray dogs and wolves mutating after Day X. Similar to packs of other canines, dorgs roam in packs and form some sort of hierarchy with the ‘alpha-beast’ in the lead. Although, encounters with them show that dorgs do not disperse after having their alpha slain, unlike packs of dogs and wolves . Apart from this, dorgs act like the regular wildlife creatures -- they have their own resting spots, hunting grounds and pretty standard behavioral patterns.

Having no fur and skin, their heads consist only of muscle tissue and bones, resembling that of an insect. Just like other mutants, bodies of dorgs are imbued with ‘The Moss’, spread throughout the entirety of their internal organs. According to some researches, dorgs don’t have a brain - instead they possess what seems to be a blister, filled with the same green liquid as the rest of the body.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/2322a7333a1e60f130d637d8563efb6e2b4d2cf1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Grutch[/b][/h1]

Grutches were species endemic to Granichny island even before the Day X.  After the events of Day X, they’ve become more aggressive and started choosing different areas of inhabitat. Grutch was a massive and dangerous beast even before the mutation, but now it poses an even bigger threat.  In the event of encountering a grutch, one is highly advised against fighting him and trying to retreat instead.

Grutches somewhat resemble a common brown bear. His mouth has multiple rows of extremely sharp teeth and there are bone growths on his chin and front legs. Some grutches also have bone outgrowths on their heads, resembling antlers. Unfortunately, most of the information is based on external observations. Transporting such a massive beast is rather problematic, and dissecting him out in the field is nearly impossible due to current hostile environment of Granichny. 

Become a cryptozoologist yourself by playing Desolate and uncovering game’s many mysteries! Get together with your friends and form a research team in online co-op!

[url=https://twitter.com/HypeTrainD][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/af35fadffa23b5833d95f44c1e6ca67873f0b25d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Key Giveaway: Remembering DESOLATE early days
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/9808871b0ef2de817a3ec781af8d088ddd4d78e8.jpg[/img]

All games come through many iterations, and very rarely the game retains all its features. And today we wanted to share some of the details about the development of Desolate!

At the early stages of development, the game was set to take place on another planet. A fragment of introductory mission sheds light on more details:

[i]"<The volunteer> was sent here, to Ansora island, for researching and uncovering data about the great calamity that happened on planet Eilot a few years ago and forever changed it.”[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/386167a030d7d001213989b0112c6d6cdaf48a10.jpg[/img]

But despite being set on another planet, the visual style of the game did already resemble that of dystopian USSR. Building a world similar to ours, but, at the same time different, also proved to be quite difficult -  as well as conveying it to the player through the game’s surroundings. This two factors became the main reason to change the setting of the game to an alternate history USSR.

Back then the game also had a bigger emphasis on  online . Upon starting the playthrough,  a player had to start a server, that could incorporate up to 12 players! Ultimately, though, it didn’t go together well with the core design of the game -- the players were mostly completing solo story missions and their interactions didn’t go much further than engaging in PvP combat. As such, the system was scrapped and instead remade into online co-op for up to 4 players.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/dedc2b7a174d3d37df35b0b7b98dd1ef7e5e06fe.jpg[/img]

Other main components of the game remained mostly the same through the years. The only exception being the firearms and shooting mechanics. In the early stages the combat was melee-oriented. 

Talking about old iterations of the game is always bittersweet. It’s fun to find out, how the project could turn out to be, but, ultimately, it would be a different game. And while we all can miss some of the earlier features -- with all things considered, the final product is almost always the best version of the game!

Greetings, Volunteers!

Join the Resistance and re-capture the territories that have been overtaken by the New Light, looted by Marauders or infested with Creatures of mysterious origin, created on Granichny. DESOLATE: The Takeover is a content update for DESOLATE, giving players new ways to fight back the forces invading Granichny Island. 

With new weapon types, armor, crafting blueprints and re-imagined enemies, the island is more dangerous than ever. Join your comrades in a blood-curdling fight for liberation, and re-take Granichny from the evil forces that have occupied it for far too long!

[h1]WATCH DEVELOPMENT UPDATE VIDEO:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9uCicpmo_Hc

[h1]Additions[/h1]

1. A new chain of side-quests, titled “Liberation”, was added to the game. Throughout this questline, the player will free parts of Granichny Island invaded by New Light forces, Marauder brigades and Creatures inhabiting the Island.  By aiding locals in their quest for liberty, you will unlock new recipes, customization elements and skill points.

The quest is available after completing the “Underground” quest of the main story line, and can be accessed on the first floor of the Oasis safe zone. 

2. Added 5 new armor blueprints - unlock them by completing the ranks of “Liberation” sidequest. 

3. Added 13 new customization items - unlock them by completing the ranks of “Liberation” sidequest. 

4. For every new rank in “Liberation” side-quest you’ll unlock a new skill point - increasing the overall number of abilities the player is able to learn.

5. 3 New recipes for food item and drinks - unlock them by completing the ranks of “Liberation” sidequest. 

6. 4 blueprints for Kunai customization — unlock them by completing the ranks of “Liberation” sidequest. 

7. 3 new grenade types added - unlock their blueprints by completing the ranks of “Liberation” sidequest. 

8. Some enemy types now have physical or psy-armor - use weapon modifications to take them down more easily. The Hunter, Sapsi and Grootch, along with every “Alpha”-type creature, have received strength upgrades. 

9. Added the Rest ability, which allows you to restore health and spend time while in a safe zone. To Rest while playing online, all players that are currently in a session will have to Rest. 

10. Added the ability to split item stacks in user’s inventory. 

11. All workshops can now be accessed directly from the HUD, by pressing the Use button near the workshop.

12. Medical Station Level 2 Workshop now has a Healing mechanic - use it to quickly regain health and cure all trauma and other negative effects. 

13. New and improved status effects (QTE):

— Bleeding is now a status effects, which is caused by receiving damage; Bandages no longer cure bleeding, but heal a small amount of health 
— Poisoning is now also a QTE status effect
— Added a new QTE status effect: Shock

3. Several fixes to tutorial interface.

4. Scrap limit increased to 999 999.

5. The Butcher now has a chance to drop purple rarity weapons. 

6.  Increased damage of DOT-effects added by weapon mods (bleed, poison, burning etc) by 50%. 

7. Peaceful creatures are now more common, their sound and sight is now reduced

8. Hunters are now more common. 

9. Armor types “Owl-M2” and “Lynx-М4” were reworked. 

10.  Some green-level modifications can now be created from a level 1 workshop. Some blue-level modifications now require a level 2 workshop to build.  

11. Changes to prologue’s closing screen - subtitles now show before the logo. 

12. You can now craft Level 1 and Level 2 items using the X-Workshop.

— added stone hit sound;
— Madmen’s volume radius increased;
— added weapon blocking sound ;
— increased volume on some of the screamers;
— increased volume on Molotov sounds;
— added sound effects for Madmen;

notes.content:

Hello, Volunteers!

We have released a new patch.

[h1]New features and updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wanogah: added two new attacks(gas cloud and toxic bombs); wanogah can get on the walls and attack from a distance, you can make it go down with ranged weapons or stones..
[*]Dorg: they have a chance to start biting your leg(QTE event). We would like to point out that current version does not have final animations and will be improved later. Extra animations need more testing and some changes to be used in multiplayer, they will be added in the future patches.

— partial optimization of assets on many locations;
— improved optimization of the following locations: Oasis safezone, Ray-1, Hospital, Radar Station “Dome”, Southern Bay Piers.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Meds, food, water, etc add a percentage of the parameter without any regard to the perks which increased them — fixed.

[h1]Answers to frequently asked questions[/h1]

[b]When will you add new quests?[/b]

We are working according to the roadmap we have posted earlier. The roadmap describes all the patches planned until the end of April.

We have described the problem we encountered with the infinite stashes. Many people experienced problems with performance and multiplayer connection due to too many items in the stash. notes.content:

Hello, Volunteers!

Patch 0.7.75 is here.

There is a new type of madmen, throwable weapons and lights, changes to the monster AI. Detailed list of changes can be found lower in the text.

We see a lot of comments about personal chest volume.

The changes made in patch 0.7.56 were the most logical and correct way to deal with the problem.  The cause is that there appear technical issues when the stash or player inventory have more than a set number of items in them. This issue prevented players from playing together in coop. Players could not connect if the number of items was too high in of the player’s inventories or stashes. Another issue was that the autosave function took much longer if the inventory was too big.

We are still testing ways to solve these issues, but we will need some more time to do it right. Thank you for patience.

[list]
[*]Localization to brazilian portuguese language.
[*]Players can craft and use grenades, throwing knives, molotovs, flares, chem lights.  
[*]In the equipment menu players can use the hotbar for items, you can equip meds, food and water, and throwable weapons in it.
[*]We have added new interface element, quick access wheel where you can choose equipped weapons and items from the hotbar.
[*]New class of madmen was added. They use torches and may set player on fire. You can meet them at night time. 
[*]New light soldiers can set player on fire with the modified mace.
[*]Marauders can set the player on fire with the molotovs. 
[*]New QTE mechanic to stop the burning when enemies have set you on fire.
[*]General improvement of the AI — blocking, attacks, debuffs for the player.
[*]Improved group fighting for the NL soldiers and marauders. They can surround players and attack together.
[*]Changed the sound of the max stress level.
[*]Added the sound of a new trophy.
[*]Merchant in Oasis now has voice lines that activate upon interaction.
[/list]

[*]Problems with the texts in interface and on the road signs — fixed.

New patch is here!

We have improved madman AI, rebalanced some aspects of the ingame economy, changed repair system and many other changes and fixes, you can read the details below.

[h1]Changes & Additions[/h1]

[list]
[*]Trader item and pricing variety re-balanced. 
[*]Added Trader item rotation - items available for sale now change once a day (in-game). 
[*]Added new Traders outside of Oasis. 
[*]Quest (Main, Side and Daily) rewards re-balanced. 
[*]Re-balanced scrap received for recycling and used for item repair. 
[*]Changes to Weapon Repair system - you can repair items a limited amount of times (the amount is based on weapon rarity), and the durability itself represents amount of hits.  Damage penalty happens on weapon break (zero durability). 
[*]Improvements to enemy’s “Sight” and “Detection” mechanics.
[*]Madman improvements - new attacks, added variety, overall damage increase 
[*]Sapsi is now more aggressive 
[*]Respawn rate of all the enemies in the “Hospital” location was increased. 
[*]Creature Trophies now can be “Researched”, which increases the creature’s rank in Monstrum 
[*]You can now craft Bullets - the item recipe and ingredients are sold by Mikhail (chance to appear in rotation)
[*]Backpack tier 3 recipe added - you can find it in “Chernovsk” location. 
[*]Unseen before paranormal entities and events now roam the Island. 
[*]Some mod ingredients now spawn more often. 
[*]Recipes for Tier 2 - Tier 4 Armor and Mods reworked 
[*]Enemies now no longer drop “Boxes of Scrap”

[*]Prologue reworked, Victor Ognin voice-over changes, some dialogue duration decreased.

notes.title: 0.7.56 — Fixes, Rebalancing and Optimization
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/6d0c8510e72e68a1d5c3592cb5e85ff7eae84bcd.jpg[/img]

Hello, Volunteers!

Next patch is already here.

[h1]Changes & Additions:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Changed the maximum number of item slots in containers to 63 - this is set to fix multiple server connectivity issues. If you had more than 63 unique items in your Stash, we highly recommend re-organizing it in Solo play, since any additional loot will disappear during online play.
[*]On inventory overload, character movement is now 50% lowered.
[*]You can now skip in-game dialogue.
[*]Enemy’s stun rate lowered across all enemy types
[*]Monstrum can now be accessed from the start 
[*]Character’s backward movement is now 25% slower
[*]Game now automatically backs up save files every 10 minutes. Save files can be located at: C:\Users\UserName\AppData\Local\Desolate\Saved\SaveGames
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Several crash and freeze-related optimisation issues fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue with enemy’s HP bar disappearing in some cases. 
[*]If you needed a quest item, and took it out of a container, the stack but not the intended amount - fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused Bread recipe not to appear 
[*]Fixed an issue which caused items in inventory to render invisible upon resuscitation. 
[*]Fixed incorrect marker placement in “Subway” location. 
[*]Fixed an issue with menu buttons rebinding .
[*]Fixed “Population control” daily quest description 
[*]Upon killing an enemy his neck stretched out - fixed. 
[*]High rank items can now be used for crafting recipes which require low rank items.
[*]Fixed an issue where healing items were rendered invisible in “Hospital” location during the main quest. 
[*]Fixed a progression issue in “Meteorology station” during main quest, where the antenna counter reset on death. When you come back to the quest zone it will show the correct number.
[*]Fixed an issue where some quests would show up as “Missing String Table Entry” during online play - if this issue persists, do not hesitate to contact us. 
[*]After modding a weapon its initial durability raised to 150%, then went back to 99% after the first hit - fixed.
[*]Changes to the Radio Tower main quest - we temporarily disabled the necessity to power up the station, just to turn on the transmission. 
[/list]

[list][*]Sound optimisation:[/list]

>Available sound channels now limited to 128 
>Footstep sounds re-sampled, duration of sound while running 50% lower
>Some non-distinct sounds from certain animations were removed  
>Footstep sound overlayed while turning - fixed
>Added priority to some sound classes. 

[list][*]Level Design:[/list]
>Location optimisation 
>Workshop on “Garages” location was locked - fixed 
>We locked down a northern part of the island that’s still in development, if you’re already there, we’ve left some ways to get back to the main area 
>Levitating vegetables put back into the ground - 6
>Semi-transparent stones fixed - 7 
>Terrain pits fxed - 3 
>Possible places for getting stuck fixed - 4 
>Items placed within other items or objects - 6.

notes.title: Use THEM to Survive on Granichny
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/7232e78e512eb2d70878c4421fba4d810ff7b57f.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Volunteers! 

These past couple of weeks were tough for us - between keeping up with the Closed Beta and preparing for release on Steam, our hands are quite full. And yet, here we are back with a new update, bringing you the latest on what’s going on with Granichny - and there’s a lot going on.

Today we’re going to shift our focus a bit - and delve deeper into different points of interest Volunteers will encounter during their shift on Granichny. Be sure to pay attention to your surroundings - these spots will definitely aid you in surviving the dangers that lurk around the island. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/39a8eff7ab74130fa61520b606446c2d398b6064.jpg[/img]

Granichny’s a big, sprawling island - so you’re gonna have a lot of land to cover during your assignment on the Island.  It’s hard to keep track of all points of interest on the island. Fortunately, the Transponders are here to help! 

Transponders are located on the top of radio towers, just like the one you see above. Upon activation they’ll update your map with every point of interest in a large area around it.  

Make sure to activate every Transponder you’ll find - that way, you’ll get to see (almost) everything Granichny has to offer! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/00feb6eb658476e2f9273de69356c384f4523eaf.jpg[/img]

Almost everything on the island is out to get you, from crazed Madmen and Dorgs to dangerous Anomalies - so death is quite a common thing in Granichny. 

However, with these wonderful pieces of New Light Technology, you’ll be able to resurrect near the closest Monolith around and continue your volunteer work! Keep in mind that after the Incident all the Monoliths broke down - so you’re going to have to repair and activate one in order to use it. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/798b623d422e4191f1dcbbea0cd3cd2b08f1a5a5.jpg[/img]

If you happen to find one of the many campfires (or any fires, for that matter) scattered around Granichny - consider yourself lucky!

The Campfire allows you to cook meals for you and your budding Volunteers from different ingredients found on the island, as well as craft healing items and other types of aid. From a simple dinner of grains and cooked meat to rubbing alcohol - use those recipes to ensure your survival. 

Of course, you’ll also find new ones around the island to put into your ever-expanding cookbook - so there’s always something new to try out around The Campfire! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/298f4ef76b196d0b1b56517524fb427a45436e2f.jpg[/img]

Since almost every part of Granichny is extremely reliant on New Light’s advanced technology, Workbenches are quite a common sight. Used for repairing and crafting different types of equipment, the Workbench is the place to go if you want to upgrade your weapons and armour.  You can also acquire new weapon and mod blueprints, which allows you to expand your arsenal, as well as upgrade the weapons you currently have.

The Incident rendered all of the Workbenches on the island unusable, but with a bit of scrap metal you’ll be able to repair them quite easily. 

***

The next update will be coming your way this weekend - and in that, we’ll dive deeper into the different weapons and mods you’ll use during your assignment on Granichny. Stay tuned!

Make sure to activate every Transponder you’ll find - that way, you’ll get to see (almost) everything Granichny has to offer! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/00feb6eb658476e2f9273de69356c384f4523eaf.jpg[/img]

Almost everything on the island is out to get you, from crazed Madmen and Dorgs to dangerous Anomalies - so death is quite a common thing in Granichny. 

However, with these wonderful pieces of New Light Technology, you’ll be able to resurrect near the closest Monolith around and continue your volunteer work! Keep in mind that after the Incident all the Monoliths broke down - so you’re going to have to repair and activate one in order to use it. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/798b623d422e4191f1dcbbea0cd3cd2b08f1a5a5.jpg[/img]

If you happen to find one of the many campfires (or any fires, for that matter) scattered around Granichny - consider yourself lucky!

The Campfire allows you to cook meals for you and your budding Volunteers from different ingredients found on the island, as well as craft healing items and other types of aid. From a simple dinner of grains and cooked meat to rubbing alcohol - use those recipes to ensure your survival. 

Of course, you’ll also find new ones around the island to put into your ever-expanding cookbook - so there’s always something new to try out around The Campfire! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/298f4ef76b196d0b1b56517524fb427a45436e2f.jpg[/img]

Since almost every part of Granichny is extremely reliant on New Light’s advanced technology, Workbenches are quite a common sight. Used for repairing and crafting different types of equipment, the Workbench is the place to go if you want to upgrade your weapons and armour.  You can also acquire new weapon and mod blueprints, which allows you to expand your arsenal, as well as upgrade the weapons you currently have.

The Incident rendered all of the Workbenches on the island unusable, but with a bit of scrap metal you’ll be able to repair them quite easily. 

***

The next update will be coming your way this weekend - and in that, we’ll dive deeper into the different weapons and mods you’ll use during your assignment on Granichny. Stay tuned!

Greetings, Volunteers! 

It’s time for a couple of important announcements:

First off, we’re excited to announce an official release date: [b]February 8th[/b] - this date will mark the release of DESOLATE in Early Access.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/9ad451d6f2efbbc804c0013ed416c7dd1bc0530d.jpg[/img]

You’ll be able to freely explore the ruins and forests of Granichny Island, filled to the brim with things to do and places to see. 

A Prologue, Act 1 and Act 2 of DESOLATE’s main story will be available at launch, along with multiple side-quests and other activities. In short, there’ll be plenty to do in the game at launch - and it only gets better from here. 

As for the second part of our announcements for today, we finally have a concrete answer for a question that’s been on everybody’s minds lately - What’s going to happen to those of us who purchased Beyond Despair before? 

(For those not in the know - Beyond Despair was a Steam title, which is currently unavailable.   It later became the foundation for DESOLATE.) 

Starting on December 14, we’ll open up a link, through which you’ll get a FREE key for Closed Beta of DESOLATE. It will be automatically updated to the release key after. You’re going to have to log in through Steam on our website - and once the system checked that you own Beyond Despair, you’ll be given the key.

We’ll talk in way more detail about different elements and aspects of DESOLATE over the coming weeks, so be sure to stay tuned and follow our official Steam Page, as well as HypeTrain Digital on [url=https://www.facebook.com/hypetraindigital/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HypeTrainD]Twitter[/url] for more info!

notes.title: Dangers Of DESOLATE - The Madmen & The Hunter
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Volunteers![/b]

This week we begin to dive deeper into the unique threats and foes that the player encounters in DESOLATE, starting off with some of the more commonly seen enemies - The Madmen and The Hunter. 

We’ll delve deeper into the flora and fauna of Granichny Island, as well as the weapons you’ll use to survive against it. Stay tuned for more in the coming days! 


[b]The Madmen[/b]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/d6d0ca7aa9b59c443cb4c0529c72d78208452725.jpg[/img]

￼
Before the event, “Madmen” used to be regular people living their lives on Granichny - now they’re nothing but rambling shadows of their former shelves. One of the United Republic of Soviets’ most popular scientific publications, “The Saturn”, described their altered state as “a kind of mental fissure”. To be more precise - something new entered their being, and remained there. Something alien. 

Despite being quite a nimble and tricky foe to fight, a single madman is not that threatening. However, if you alert him of to your presence - Madman yells and growls will instantly attract more of their kind. 


[b]The Hunter[/b]
￼

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/5e7f8c34ce8e1999d656f74a247acdb86ae5a4ec.jpg[/img]


The Hunter can appear behind your back at any second - and you wouldn’t even know it. And if you do - it’s probably going to be too late. 

It may very well just be a rumor, but there’s a tale going around Granichny about The Hunter: he used to be a serial killer, who became a test subject for New Light’s Matter Converter. Due to technical miscalculations, the psychopathic killer mysteriously disappeared - only to come back several days later, in his “transformed” state. 

Fighting a Hunter is extremely tough - one moment you swing your weapon to bash his skull in, the other - he’s already teleported away, preparing to strike at any second.
